integrity.computations: Exact symbolic identities; no numerical experiment used as proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact polynomial identities, Kodaira fiber data, Shioda-Tate, height pairing, and the rational elliptic surface discriminant formula.

scientific_limitations: The result is over the complex numbers and concerns the generic elliptic curve over the line parameter.

The abstract Mordell-Weil groups and height lattices are consequences of the classical reducible-fiber classification; the claimed addition is the explicit parameter-dependent order-two section on the tangent locus.

The older classification paper full text was not accessible from its official repository during this run; its abstract group implications are recorded as a coverage limitation rather than as independently re-audited evidence.
title: A torsion jump on tangent slices of the tetrahedral elliptic family
